train_rubric.use: training set of every four-family rubric comparison run

val_fast.use: per-epoch learning curves only, never a headline number

rubric_budget.resize: keep aspect ratio, long side 1344 px (torchvision: max_size=1344, min_size=756; Ultralytics/RT-DETR: imgsz=1344 letterbox)
rubric_budget.batch_size: framework/memory dependent, recorded per run; images_seen is what stays fixed

estimate.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU 8 GB, torch 2.14.1+cu130, AMP fp16, batch 2, synthetic 1904x1071 inputs with 45 boxes, random weights, no data loading
estimate.reasoning: 16800 images / 8.38 img/s = 33 min of training for the slowest torchvision family, leaving about 40% headroom for JPEG decoding, masking and 6 val_fast evaluations within 60 min. Ultralytics YOLO11 and RT-DETR were not installed at freeze time; RT-DETR feasibility on 8 GB is gate G9 (CH-11).

preprocessing.normalization: ImageNet mean/std (torchvision model transform); Ultralytics models use their built-in 0-1 scaling
preprocessing.augmentation_rubric_baselines: horizontal flip p=0.5 only (Ultralytics: mosaic=0, mixup=0, hsv/scale/translate off). Any extra augmentation is a recorded tuning experiment

label_map.yolo_class: category_id - 1 (0-7); the provided labels/ files already follow it (verified on 24,339 boxes, 0 mismatches)

ignore_policy.semantics: ignore/<clip>/<frame>.txt lines are 'cx cy w h' normalised, no class; they are the VisDrone 'ignored regions' (orig 0) and 'others' (orig 11). annotations_coco.json holds the same regions, each repeated once per category 1-8 with iscrowd=1, ignore=1
ignore_policy.training: drop crowd annotations from targets; fill each ignore region with ignore_fill_rgb except pixels inside labelled target boxes (movd.data.mask_ignore_regions / training_sample)
ignore_policy.evaluation: pycocotools COCOeval on the unchanged GT JSON, crowd annotations kept: detections matched to a crowd region (intersection / detection area >= IoU threshold) are ignored, for every class. Implemented in movd/evaluate.py (CH-03)

inference.boxes: original image pixels, [x, y, w, h]

prediction_interchange.format: COCO results JSON: [{image_id:int, category_id:1-8, bbox:[x,y,w,h] original pixels, score:float}]
prediction_interchange.test_image_id: 1-based row number in test_images.csv (movd.data.load_test_images 'id'); the submission uses the CSV image_id string ('image_key')
